tool_args.rationale: The observations are close to a linear steady-state response at long horizons, consistent with the verified adiabatic relaxation mechanism and damped fast transient. Fit both parameters numerically and test on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A fitted relaxation model incorporates the observed damped transient while remaining parsimonious.
Their stated forms omit the observed initial-state dependence described by the adiabatic mechanism.
Five long-horizon observations constrain the two-parameter coarse model; fresh confirmation can test it without an additional probe.
